topics.question: Why can dating one Puranic passage differ from dating its surrounding compilation?

topics.question: Why do lists of Puranas and sectarian classifications vary across sources?

topics.question: How can two translations of a Puranic passage make different theological relationships appear explicit?
topics.coverage: Compare Sanskrit terms, supplied words, footnotes, commentarial affiliations and narrative context; distinguish defensible interpretation from a fabricated quotation.
